card.title: 89th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 89th Infantry Regiment were attached to the 23rd Rifle Division of the Red Army. During WWII the 23rd engaged in several military campaigns, including the Battle of Stalingrad, the Battle of Kiev in 1943, Operation Bagration and the Berlin Offensive. In 1943 it became the 71st Guards Rifle Division for its actions in the Battle of Stalingrad and was awarded the Order of the Red Banner, the Order of Suvorov 2nd Class, and the Order of Kutuzov 2nd Class for its actions.
